method: Exact Gaussian state marginalization; PyMC NUTS; SC01 mixture-CDF quantiles

parameters.target: Retrospective conditional prediction of eligible 2016 PM2.5 at an omitted monitored station, using observed wind and the complete 2016 outcome panel from ten training stations. Training-year smoothing may use later other-site outcomes; not forecasting, exposure estimation or causality.

model_definition.wind: Population-SD standardization from base training rows only; same constants for all final fits
model_definition.season: Sine and cosine, period 366, centered on complete fixed calendar
model_definition.mean: alpha + beta*x + gamma_s*S + gamma_c*C + b0_site + b1_site*x + u_day
model_definition.temporal: u0~Normal(0,a_u^2); u_t|u_(t-1)~Normal(phi*u_(t-1),q); q=a_u^2*(1-phi^2); every calendar day including missing
model_definition.priors_status: Illustrative assumptions, must undergo training-only prior prediction and final numeric freeze
model_definition.likelihood: Exact daily grouped Gaussian Kalman marginal likelihood with within-day sums of squares, log(n), variance normalizers and stationary initial density; see complete derivation in case_design.md
model_definition.initial_backend: float64 PyTensor scan with explicit strict nonsequences; compare default and installed NUMBA compilation
model_definition.gradient_fallback: Numba Op with analytic likelihood sensitivities, independently checked; no production finite differences
model_definition.potential_prediction: Explicit prior/PPC/new-site simulators required; Potential is not an observation simulator

prior_prediction.decision: Retain illustrative priors for training benchmark. Wide tails are intentional prior uncertainty, not observed environmental evidence. Report only predictive quantiles/densities; no physical moment claims. Same point rule for all four models and all weather rows.
limitations: Paired-hour wind depends on outcome availability flags, as frozen, but not concentration values.
Covariate threshold counts are not final concentration summaries.
No claim that rows below a sufficient threshold have finite physical moments.

resources.scope: Measured four-role final evaluation; includes base execution reuse, all final inspections/sealing/scoring and conservative full cold-backend charge

retained_at_scoring_completion.scope: All C03 gate/final evidence, including failures and duplicates; raw/env excluded

scoring.method: Foreground child and recursive descendants sampled via pinned psutil; child aggregate CPU from wait/rusage; monitor overhead excluded from child RSS. Sampling can miss sub-50ms peaks.

resources.cost_policy: Sum sequential measured commands, not elapsed authoring time. Base fit is charged once here and also visible in development history; do not add the overlapping scopes as unique work.
resources.cpu_scope: Process-tree monitor CPU includes waited-for compiler children; original reused base and inspection report parent CPU only. No falsely precise unified CPU total.

aborted.reason: Unrepresentable warmup proposal caused custom gradient zero division; mathematical model unchanged by recorded rejection repair.
aborted.partial_draws: Sampling aborted before return; no partial trace artifact was available. Full traceback, seed, configuration and logged inputs retained.

exclusions.environment: Pinned .venv and compiler caches are excluded from retained teaching results; lockfile and versions are bound.

resources.package_rendering_costs: Notebook/script/tests and final storage are measured separately in package verification; not sampling or another holdout evaluation.

outcome_exposure.meaning: First declared access to final concentrations, after all four corrected predictions sealed
outcome_exposure.rule: No score-informed refitting; any later revision is development requiring fresh outer validation

metrics.scientific_acceptance: pending; material training residual misfit remains
metrics.computation_mode: Authenticated replay; three new final MCMC fits plus one freeze-authorized base reuse; one recorded evaluation

limitations: Training residual autocorrelation, unequal dispersion and skewness remain; no likelihood-adequacy or calibration claim.
Seasonal/state projections are nearly perfectly negatively correlated; separate physical attribution is unsupported.
Only ten training sites and two final sites; correlation and transport to other locations remain uncertain.
Paired-hour missingness and nearest-station weather may be informative or share measurement error.
Historical conditional smoothing uses the entire training year; not a forecast, exposure estimate or causal analysis.
SC01: finite empirical MAE/RMSE of the predictive median do not establish finite expected losses or Bayes optimality.
Marginal intervals are not simultaneous bands; marginal log scores are not a joint trajectory density.
Numerical MCSE is not sampling uncertainty across independent days or a confidence interval across sites.
The final sites are now exposed; further score-informed changes are development requiring fresh outer validation.
AI-reviewed locally verified draft; scientific acceptance, human review and publication integration remain pending.
